rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: Guideline-level support only. MISEV2023 justifies the principles and types of data that de-risk advancing intact-EV formulations (orthogonal QC panels, defined release criteria, fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays, and stability/potency linkage), but it does not supply program-specific demonstrations required to conclude SGL-001 meets those criteria.
findings: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) provides consensus recommendations for orthogonal EV characterization, transparent production reporting, and validated functional/assay strategies but is a guideline, not program-specific data.
No program-level CMC, assay validation, manufacturing comparability, stability-linked potency, or GLP large-animal biodistribution data are present in the permitted evidence set.
From the available evidence alone, claims that SGL-001 has met (or must be presumed to have met) specific Stage-1 CMC/gating deliverables are unsupported.
objections: MISEV2023 is an expert-consensus guideline and does not itself constitute program-level CMC, assay validation, batch comparability, stability/potency linkage, or GLP biodistribution evidence for SGL-001; therefore it cannot prove that the specific gating package items are complete or required without additional program data.

claim_updates.rationale: Only guideline-level recommendations are available; no program-specific CMC, assay validation, or batch comparability evidence was provided.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 has produced program-level MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV release assays, and GMP-like batch comparability data sufficient to support advancement.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV recommends reporting scale and controls but provides no program-specific scale-up runs, MCB/WCB reports, or GMP-like batch data for SGL-001.
claim_updates.statement: Manufacturing scale-up and reproducible lot-to-lot performance for SGL-001 have been demonstrated.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV provides guidance on reporting and controls but does not provide program-specific biodistribution or GLP large-animal bridging data required to establish a gating checklist for this program.
claim_updates.statement: Rodent intranasal biodistribution data plus MISEV guidance alone establish a program-level gating checklist applicable to SGL-001 for cross-species advancement.

decision_update.question: May SGL-001 advance to cross-species PK/PD and lot-comparison studies based on currently provided evidence?
decision_update.rationale: Current evidence set contains only MISEV guidance (guideline-level support) and lacks program-specific CMC, assay validation, batch comparability, stability/potency linkage, and GLP large-animal biodistribution data required to de-risk advancement.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: MISEV2023 describes best-practice characterization and reporting expectations but is not a program-level certification of compliance; guideline recommendations do not replace program-specific validation and regulatory input.

hypothesis_update.rationale: MISEV2023 supports this principle at the guideline level, but program-specific data are missing to confirm SGL-001 meets gating requirements.
hypothesis_update.statement: A defined CMC/analytics/formulation compatibility gating package is required before advancing intranasal intact-EV formulation into cross-species PK/PD and lot-comparison studies.

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble and submit program-specific evidence: MCB/WCB dossiers, orthogonal intact-EV assay validation reports (with LLOQ/specificity/precision), stability-linked potency assay development and bridging data, three GMP-like batch reports with stability and comparability analyses, and GLP/equivalent large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox study reports. After submission, convene a multidisciplinary review (CMC, manufacturing, nonclinical, regulatory) and prepare a regulator briefing package.

risk_updates.description: Without validated orthogonal identity assays, stability-linked potency assays, and batch comparability, observed biological differences may reflect undetected product variability rather than true PD effects.
risk_updates.mitigation: Provide MCB/WCB dossiers, orthogonal assay validation, stability/potency bridging, and GMP-like batch comparability reports; perform lot-release and stability testing before cross-lot comparisons.
risk_updates.title: Uncontrolled product identity and potency variability

risk_updates.description: Guideline recommendations do not substitute for GLP large-animal biodistribution/toxicity studies and validated detection of intact EV across species; translational assumptions remain unproven.
risk_updates.mitigation: Generate GLP or equivalent large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox studies with validated detection assays and appropriate controls; include species-bridging analyses.
risk_updates.title: Uncertain cross-species intranasal delivery and biodistribution

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not advance to cross-species PK/PD or lot-comparison studies until program-specific CMC and analytical evidence are assembled and reviewed. Required deliverables to assemble: (1) MCB/WCB creation and characterization dossiers with release criteria; (2) fit-for-purpose validation reports for orthogonal intact-EV release/assay methods (including LLOQ, specificity, accuracy, precision); (3) a stability-indicating potency assay and bridging data linking assay readout to an in vivo PD endpoint; (4) three GMP-like batch manufacturing reports with release testing, stability data, and comparability analyses; and (5) GLP (or equivalent) large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox reports with appropriate controls and validated detection methods. Prepare a regulator briefing package after assembling these items. Major therapeutic advancement decisions require human approval and should remain pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported (guideline-only): MISEV2023 provides consensus-level recommendations for transparent, orthogonal characterization, defined release criteria, and validated assays, but the provided evidence set contains only the guideline and no program-specific CMC or validation data. Therefore, the claim that a program must produce MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV release assays, and GMP-like batch comparability before advancement cannot be fully supported by the available evidence alone.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC: defined/qualified MCB/WCB records, scale-up process description and qualification runs, validated intact-EV release assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision), stability-indicating potency assay data, and GMP-like batch comparability reports.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: MISEV2023 recommends detailed production reporting and controls but does not provide any program-level evidence that scalable, reproducible manufacturing (MCB/WCB generation, scale-up runs, or release/stability data) has been established. The production/scalability claim cannot be evaluated from the guideline alone.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing manufacturing evidence: MCB/WCB creation and characterization reports, process scale-up/transfer documentation, three GMP-like batch reports with release and stability data, and comparability analyses across lots.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported (guideline-only support for high-level requirements): MISEV2023 explicitly recommends orthogonal characterization, transparent reporting of separation/purification methods, and validated functional/assay strategies. These guideline-level recommendations support the principle that orthogonal QC and validated intact-EV assays are needed to de-risk identity and potency claims before formulation advancement; however, because only the guideline is available, program-specific assay validation metrics, stability/potency correlation data, and in vivo bridging evidence are absent and the claim cannot be fully supported from the available evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing analytical and in-vivo evidence: validated intact-EV assays (fit-for-purpose validation reports), orthogonal QC data from multiple lots, stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint, and cross-species biodistribution bridging studies with appropriate controls.

verification_objections: That program-specific MCB/WCB creation and characterization dossiers exist or have been produced (no MCB/WCB records present in provided evidence).

That fit-for-purpose validation reports for orthogonal intact-EV release assays (including LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision) have been performed and are available (no assay validation data present).
That a stability-indicating potency assay has been developed and linked to an in vivo PD endpoint (no stability/potency correlation data present).
That three GMP-like batch manufacturing reports with release, stability, and comparability analyses have been completed (no batch manufacturing or comparability reports present).
That GLP or equivalent large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox studies with appropriate controls demonstrating intact-EV detection have been completed (no GLP biodistribution/tox data present).
